cases.description: A CommonJS package waits for a flush-requested exclusive temporary-file write before renaming it and publishing its completion marker. File checks do not certify power-loss durability.
An ESM package supplies a DataView and a Uint16Array with nonzero offsets; pathname writes consume raw viewed bytes, preserve append flags and encode a hexadecimal suffix.

cases.description: A package rejects invalid flush settings, pre-abort, and an exclusive-open collision without truncating the existing release or creating a success file.

files.attempts.cjs: const fs=require('fs/promises');module.exports=async function(){const results=[];try{await fs.writeFile('release.txt','bad',{flush:'yes'});await fs.writeFile('unexpected.txt','invalid option accepted');}catch(e){results.push(e.code);}const c=new AbortController();c.abort(false);try{await fs.writeFile('release.txt','bad',{flush:true,signal:c.signal});await fs.writeFile('unexpected.txt','abort accepted');}catch(e){results.push(e.code+':'+(e.cause===false));}try{await fs.writeFile('release.txt','bad',{flag:'wx',flush:true});await fs.writeFile('unexpected.txt','collision accepted');}catch(e){results.push(e.code);}return results;};

cases.description: A package writes through a FileHandle owned by its caller; both Promise namespace operations retain the descriptor cursor and leave closing to the caller.

files.main.cjs: const fs=require('node:fs/promises');const edit=require('fixture-edit');async function run(){const h=await fs.open('data.txt','r+');await h.read(Buffer.alloc(2));await edit(h);console.log('PROMISE_HANDLE_OPEN',h.fd>=0);await h.close();console.log('PROMISE_HANDLE_COMPLETE',h.fd);}run();

cases.description: A scalar write is followed by an iterable append that aborts between chunks. Rejection must preserve only accepted bytes, close the producer and refuse a successful completion file.
